title: Cancel wetland excavation project in eastern Assam grazing grounds, CM urged

ai.summary: Farmers and fishing communities in eastern Assam urged Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma to cancel wetland excavation in historic grazing grounds after a sit-in protest in Guwahati on November 17, 2026.

facts.claim: Farmers and fishing community members in eastern Assam’s Teok region have urged Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma to scrap an ongoing “anti-people” project in “historic” grazing grounds and natural wetlands.
facts.quote: Farmers and fishing community members in eastern Assam’s Teok region have urged Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma to scrap an ongoing “anti-people” project in “historic” grazing grounds and natural wetlands.

facts.claim: They submitted a memorandum to the Chief Minister after staging a sit-in protest in Guwahati on Tuesday (November 17, 2026) against the project being implemented “in the guise of” a Flood Mitigation by Capacity Augmentation of Wetlands scheme.
facts.quote: They submitted a memorandum to the Chief Minister after staging a sit-in protest in Guwahati on Tuesday (November 17, 2026) against the project being implemented “in the guise of” a Flood Mitigation by Capacity Augmentation of Wetlands scheme.

facts.claim: The Teok Ban Niskashan Nala Khanan Dabi Samiti, a collective of villagers around the 7,598 bighas (almost 2,512 acres) under excavation, organised the protest.
facts.quote: The Teok Ban Niskashan Nala Khanan Dabi Samiti, a collective of villagers around the 7,598 bighas (almost 2,512 acres) under excavation, organised the protest.

facts.claim: They said the authorities began implementing the project in January without any open public hearings, independent Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA), Social Impact Assessment (SIA) or public consent.
facts.quote: They said the authorities began implementing the project in January without any open public hearings, independent Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA), Social Impact Assessment (SIA) or public consent.

facts.claim: Located in Jorhat district, Teok is about 330 km east of Guwahati.
facts.quote: Located in Jorhat district, Teok is about 330 km east of Guwahati.

facts.claim: The Hindu had reported on the first resistance in February-March after police served a notice to Debanga Sourav Gogoi, the Samiti’s advisor, for allegedly instigating villagers against the project involving the grazing grounds and the Jelengitup-Ghorachowa, Kenduguri, Garchiga and Kawaimari wetlands.
facts.quote: The Hindu had reported on the first resistance in February-March after police served a notice to Debanga Sourav Gogoi, the Samiti’s advisor, for allegedly instigating villagers against the project involving the grazing grounds and the Jelengitup-Ghorachowa, Kenduguri, Garchiga and Kawaimari wetlands.

facts.claim: Mr. Gogoi said representatives from various progressive organisations, farmer organisations, political parties, students’ unions and civil society participated in Tuesday’s protest to express solidarity with the Samiti.
facts.quote: Mr. Gogoi said representatives from various progressive organisations, farmer organisations, political parties, students’ unions and civil society participated in Tuesday’s protest to express solidarity with the Samiti.

facts.claim: The organisation wants the government to stop the excavation work; conduct a transparent and open public hearing in each project area involving independent environmental experts, public representatives, agriculturists, livestock farmers, fishermen and other affected citizens; and ensure legal protection of ancestral rights over the grazing grounds and traditional fishing rights in the targeted wetlands.
facts.quote: The organisation wants the government to stop the excavation work; conduct a transparent and open public hearing in each project area involving independent environmental experts, public representatives, agriculturists, livestock farmers, fishermen and other affected citizens; and ensure legal protection of ancestral rights over the grazing grounds and traditional fishing rights in the targeted wetlands.

ai.background_note: Farmers and fishing communities in eastern Assam have protested against wetland excavation in historic grazing grounds, demanding an end to the project and legal protection of ancestral rights.
